description: Incredible Resort-Style living in a decent-sized, 2,140 sq ft TownHome w split floor plan. Features include 2-Story formal living room w fireplace, Dining, Family room, and powder room. A wet bar & powder room on the main level; 2nd floor offers 2 spacious en-suites w a large walking closet & bathroom in each bedroom. Recessed lighting throughout. Hardwood flooring on the 1st floor & carpet upstairs; 2-car garage, plenty of storage space, washer & dryer in the garage; Townhome w a private patio and garden view. This gated community offers a pool, spa, beautiful mature trees all around, lush landscaping w sitting area, and plenty of guest parking, proximity to Gelson's, Trader Joe's, and many restaurants. There is a special assessment that is negotiable.
